# This test checks that "go mod tidy -x" print
# commands tidy executes.
# Verifies golang.org/issue/35849

rm $GOPATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/rsc.io/quote
go mod tidy
! stderr 'get '$TESTGO_GOPROXY

rm $GOPATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/rsc.io/quote
# The build cache holds the go.mod files the first tidy fetched. An empty one makes this tidy fetch them.
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache-empty
go mod tidy -x
stderr 'get '$TESTGO_GOPROXY

-- go.mod --
module example.com/mod

-- a.go --
package mod
import _ "rsc.io/quote"
